source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
    ACH_BatchNumber, 
    ACH_TraceNumber, 
    ACH_TransNumber,
    CAST(NEWID() AS VARCHAR(50)) AS External_Id
FROM abhi.sf_test 
WHERE SyncStatus = 'pending'

SELECT 
    External_Id,
    Payload,
    Error_Message,
    CONCAT(External_Id, '-', FORMAT(CreatedAt, 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')) AS Request_Received_At
FROM abhi.ai_appraisal_data
WHERE SyncStatus = 'pending'

WITH base_data
AS (
	SELECT t2.account_no
		,FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyyMMdd_hhmmss') AS batch_id
		,t1.api_rk
		,t1.api_code
		,REPLACE(t1.api_url, '#ACCOUNT_NO', t2.account_no) AS api_url
		,t1.api_desc
		,t1.api_type
		,t1.api_prop
		,t1.api_override_applicable
		,t1.api_override_parameter_value
		,t1.last_run_successfully
		,t1.execution_seq_no
		,t1.valid_flag
		,t1.valid_from_date
		,t1.valid_to_date
		,t1.created_by
		,t1.created_on
		,t1.updated_by
		,t1.updated_on
		,t1.token
		,t1.dbase_name
		,CAST(t2.loan_rk AS VARCHAR(10)) + '_' + t2.account_no AS key_value
	FROM vw_api_master t1
	CROSS JOIN dim_loan t2
	WHERE t1.api_code = 'GET_LOAN_BY_AN'
		AND t2.valid_flag = 'Y'
	)
	,numbered_data
AS (
	SELECT *
		,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
			ORDER BY key_value ASC
			) AS RowNumber
		,-- Sequential numbering (no gaps)
		COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
	FROM base_data
	)
INSERT INTO LoanAdditionalInfoAPI (
	is_last_row
	,total_count
	,RowNumber
	,GroupNumber
	,account_no
	,api_rk
	,api_code
	,api_url
	,token
	,dbase_name
	,key_value
	)
SELECT CASE 
		WHEN RowNumber = total_count
			THEN '1'
		ELSE '0'
		END AS is_last_row
	,total_count
	,RowNumber
	,((RowNumber - 1) / 450) + 1 AS GroupNumber
	,account_no
	,api_rk
	,api_code
	,api_url
	,token
	,dbase_name
	,key_value
FROM numbered_data
ORDER BY RowNumber;

SELECT 1;

WITH Years AS (
    SELECT 2012 AS Year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Year + 1
    FROM Years
    WHERE Year < 2026
)
SELECT
    Year,
    'https://api-ca.themortgageoffice.com/LSS.svc/GetLoansByTimestamp/'
    + FORMAT(DATEFROMPARTS(Year, 1, 1), 'MM-dd-yyyy') + ' 00:00:00/'
    + FORMAT(DATEFROMPARTS(Year, 12, 31), 'MM-dd-yyyy') + ' 23:59:59'
    AS ApiUrl
FROM Years
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100)
